description: Filter federal contract awards by exact fields — recipient, awarding agency, NAICS code, state — instead of keyword search. Includes a single-bid filter for awards that drew exactly one offer. Use this when you know the slice you want; use get_award_history for topic/keyword search. Requires a BidCatch intel key.

one_bid_only.description: true = only awards that received exactly one offer

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. TX

name: search_awards
